title: senna angustisiliqua var. inaguensis
intro: Senna angustisiliqua var. inaguensis, commonly known as a variety of the senna plant, is a leguminous shrub native to the Caribbean. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating constipation, digestive issues, and certain skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis, due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna angustisiliqua var. inaguensis are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relax the muscles in the digestive tract, providing relief from symptoms associated with constipation and other gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Senna angustisiliqua var. inaguensis include anthraquinone glycosides, such as sensnosides A and B, which are responsible for its laxative effects.
